description: Ex-Soviet airframe donated by the Soviet garrison at Szprotawa-Wiechlice and unveiled 9 May 1985 as a monument to the 40th anniversary of the victory over fascism; the plaque was cast by Dolnośląskie Zakłady Odlewnicze on the initiative of the local LOK branch. Repainted in Polish Air Force markings after 1989 but Soviet red stars remain visible under the paint on the fin — the Polish markings it now wears are NOT its identity. Local sources call it a MiG-21F rather than an F-13 on the basis of its twin NR-30 cannon; unverified on site
